heading: A NEW VOICE FOR MIAMI IN WASHINGTON
text: Eddy Rojas came to Miami from Cuba with a dream and a work ethic that wouldn't quit. Over the past 20 years, he built a successful service company from the ground up — going from parking cars to leading one of Florida's most respected service businesses.

heading: A NEW VOICE FOR MIAMI IN WASHINGTON
text: He knows what it means to work hard, raise a family, and fight for the American Dream. Now, Eddy is running for Congress to bring that same dedication and honesty to Washington — because Miami's hardworking families deserve a representative who truly understands their struggles.

heading: Family. Faith. Hard Work.
text: "My family is my anchor. Everything I do is for their future — and for every family in District 28."
